desc:
👯 Create the best matching avatars to win the fashion show!

⏰ You'll have 7 minutes to style 2 avatars to a theme 

⭐ Your avatars walk the runway, and get scored by other players

🏆 Winner is the pair with the highest scores! 

✅ Play solo or duo, you ALWAYS get to create a matching look

☁️ Earn cash each round that helps you decorate your DREAM boutique! More decor coming soon

ALL OUTFIT CREATED HERE CAN BE IMPORTED INTO AVATAR STYLER CATALOG 📩 simply join the game! Find it in our community: Cyber Glass

Join the community for updates and a special in game rank + tag 💜
